home.faqSubtitle: Straight answers — no jargon, no fluff

faqs.question: What is an AI automation system?
faqs.answer: A set of AI agents and integrations that take over one recurring job in your business end to end — answering enquiries, following up leads, processing documents or reporting results. We connect it to the tools you already use (WhatsApp, calendar, CRM, email, accounting), train it on your services and run it for you. There is nothing for your team to install or learn.

faqs.question: Do I need all four systems?
faqs.answer: No. Most clients start with the capture system so every WhatsApp and web enquiry is answered within seconds, then add follow-up and reporting once they see the results. The four systems are built to work together, but each one works on its own — you add the next step when you're ready.

faqs.question: How fast is it live?
faqs.answer: The free AI audit takes 3 days and gives you the top automation opportunities for your business. After that, the capture system is typically live within 2 weeks, and a full setup with follow-up, operations and reporting takes 2–4 weeks — including connecting your WhatsApp Business number, training the AI on your services and testing with your team.

faqs.question: Does it work for my clinic or small business?
faqs.answer: Yes, if your customers reach you on WhatsApp, email or web forms. Our deepest experience is with hair transplant, dental, cosmetic surgery and IVF clinics — including medical tourism providers — and with real estate agencies, e-commerce stores, finance and legal firms and service businesses. The AI replies in 50+ languages, so international customers are covered too.

faqs.question: What does it cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on how many systems you need, how many locations or inboxes you run and which tools we connect. We offer three tiers — Starter, Growth and Scale — mapped to the four systems, and every tier is quoted after a free audit, so you only pay for what will actually save you time. There is no long-term contract.

faqs.question: Does it replace my staff?
faqs.answer: No — it replaces the repetitive work your staff do today: first replies at midnight, chasing leads that went quiet, copying data from documents into spreadsheets, building weekly reports. Your team still handles consultations, complex questions and decisions, and the AI hands over to a human whenever one is needed.
